label: Spinoza resolved mind-body dualism through substance monism (Deus sive Natura)
description: Baruch Spinoza formulated a fundamental critique of "Substance Dualism (Mind vs. Matter)", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Substance Dualism (Mind vs. Matter)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Early Modern & Scientific.
